Optional absence remains permitted; explicit null and 17 remain the listed present durable values. The wider nullable-integer transport/application type does not erase the selected durable constraint. No valid-input rejection policy, branch repair or narrowing was inserted to make the components easier to support. No invention: the V1 envelope, deterministic document ID, normalized schema tag and identity are packaging bookkeeping, not new behavioral requirements; all prescribed behavioral content comes from the approved component selection and two clauses.

Mechanical recovery is limited evidence. project deep-copies the full context and turns only recognized relation kinds/parameters into V1 requirement objects with unchanged IDs. recover checks complete context equality and exact supplemental ID-set preservation, then reconstructs relation objects while copying original provenance, statements, issues and other fields. compare_relations can establish bounded structural/clause equality but does not independently derive or recover prose meaning. Reviewer semantics establish why P01 authorizes this context, why these particular requirement objects preserve both clauses, and why the source's no-additional-supplemental boundary is respected. Successful recovery is not itself that judgment.

The reviewer remains distinct from R5.80.coordinator, but same-family AI procedural isolation is not independent human, organizational or cross-model validation. Qualification's protection claims were not independently audited.

A structurally complete document can faithfully preserve invalid or unsupported behavior. In particular, retaining the broad integer input, its unconditional selected operation structure and the narrower durable-content constraints does not prove successful storage for every integer, valid transitions under existing semantics, or current consumer support. This receipt approves preservation without repairing those components, and makes no full semantic-validity, satisfiability, readiness or acceptance claim.

P01 is explicit selection of exact public application/configuration components plus two already recognized supplemental forms. Its successful projection does not independently imply arbitrary prose representability, a generic FRC-to-V1 mapper, reliable real-user elicitation, or impossibility of representing the other sources. No authority for actual held-out benchmark exposure or a new freeze follows.
